title: Assess open space to lower flood insurance cost (PAD-US, Georgetown County SC)
method: PADUS_CRS_clip_1.tif is a thematic raster of PAD-US unit OBJECTIDs (EPSG:5070, 30 m) with NoData 2147483648. Reclassify valid PAD-US cells to 1 (open space) and NoData to 0, write open_space.tif, vectorize class 1 into polygons, attach per-polygon area (m2, acres, and acres x 0.85 for the lesson's 85 % accuracy factor) and report the total: 294 448 cells = 265.00 km2 = 65 484 acres (55 661 acres adjusted).
benchmark_defects: The benchmark distributes GeorgetownCo_Parcels and PADUS_CRS_attrib only as .lyrx layer files; here they are supplied as data. The instruction asks only for reclassify + vectorize + total area (it does not use the parcels); the parcel-level zonal statistics of the Human Designed Workflow are not part of the instruction and are not judged.
Dataset description refers to PADUS_CRS_final.tif; the file supplied (and named in the instruction) is PADUS_CRS_clip_1.tif.
'reclassify based on a threshold' is ambiguous: the raster holds protected-area IDs, so the only meaningful threshold is valid vs NoData; thresholding the ID values is meaningless.
Domain knowledge mentions NLCD impervious-surface accuracy (85 %), which only makes sense for the parcel-level acreage of the original lesson.
checks: required: open-space cells (==1 / >0) agree with gold, IoU >= 0.95 (pred warped to gold grid if needed)
required: polygon union area IoU with gold >= 0.95 (class-1 only if a 0/1 class column exists)

required: an area attribute equal to the equal-area (EPSG:5070) polygon area in m2/km2/ha/acres/sq ft/sq mi (x0.85 allowed): per polygon median rel. error <= 3 % and r >= 0.99, or the total +/-3 % for < 3 features (square degrees / cell counts fail)
required (the instruction asks for the total area): total of the area attribute equals the gold total in a common unit (m2, km2, ha, acres, sq ft, sq mi; x0.85 allowed), +/-3 %
